items.label: l'aide
items.scene: A nurse opens a first-AID kit to HELP a boy with a grazed knee, his TEDDY ("ehd") holding the plasters.

items.label: l'urgence
items.scene: An EMERGENCY ("ewr-ZHAHNS")! a hedgehog nurse races a squeaky trolley along the green line, quills flying.

items.label: l'ambulance
items.scene: A small smiling AMBULANCE ("ahn-bew-LAHNS") with a LANCE-shaped aerial parks just inside the wide doors, lights twinkling.

items.label: l'opération
items.scene: A surgeon sings OPERA ("oh-pay-rah-SYOHN") behind a half-open curtain during a teddy's OPERATION, stitching his arm back on.

items.label: l'hôpital
items.scene: A TALL nurse on stilts ("oh-pee-TAHL", no S and no H) hands a boy in a wheelchair a flower PETAL as he arrives at the HOSPITAL.

items.label: le secours
items.scene: A St Bernard brings HELP: a teddy skier in a bobble hat rides strapped on SECURE ("suh-KOOR"), and a steaming mug of cocoa sits on the sled.

items.label: le patient
items.scene: A PATIENT ("pah-SYAHN") elephant sits waiting calmly on a bench far too small, reading a tiny magazine.
